definition: a device that stores computer data
description: An opened computer hard drive stands upright on a block of black cooled lava at night. Its metal case shows the shiny round disk, the spindle and the read arm, and the cover plate leans beside it. A small drop of glowing orange lava bubbles at its base and thin smoke curls up around it, while bright lava trickles down cracks in the rock. Behind it a river of molten lava flows across the dark ground and a volcano throws up fire and smoke under a starry sky.

en.question: Where is the hard drive standing?

es.answer: Está colocado sobre un bloque de lava.
es.question: ¿Dónde está colocado el disco duro?

fr.answer: Il se dresse sur un bloc de lave.

cracher du feu et de la fumée
